package.name: crowd_nav_safety_supervisor
package.description: Phase 9: forward-sim + costmap/keepout collision check, OOD detector (crowd size, proximity, relative speed, command limit, low perception confidence), per-cause intervention logging (InterventionEvent). Pure C++ core (no live ROS node needed for its own logic) instantiated directly by crowd_nav_controller, sharing its exact costmap_ros_ instance rather than an independent subscription (S4.8.2).
